_comment: Blank campaign-drafts template for a competitive-mode MetaTask (protocol v1.3 draft). Copy this file, fill every REPLACE marker, then gate on: python3 scripts/metatask-wizard/validate-task-draft.py <your-file>.json -> TASK DRAFT READY. Publish with metatask_publish (draftsFile mode + taskId). Shape mirrors scripts/metatask-v13-pilot/pilot-task-drafts.json (the golden sample).
campaign: REPLACE: one-line campaign description (N nodes, competitive mode, weight sum 10000)
campaignStatus: REPLACE: e.g. DRAFTS VALIDATED LOCALLY - not yet published. Note the H_ACT3 activation state and whether allowPreActivation: true is needed (draft section 7 escape hatch).

protocol.activationNote: Competitive mode is gated on H_ACT3 (draft section 7). Before activation, publishing needs metatask_publish's allowPreActivation: true writer-side escape hatch; replay applies no height gate.

specValidationReading: Every spec carries the v1.2.1 three-item validation block (mandatory at/after H_ACT2=191500): null_tolerance boolean true, enumeration_closure with a closure string plus integer self-check counts, and proposition_fidelity referencing an INDEPENDENT correspondence artifact published BEFORE the specs (placeholder ARTIFACT_PIN:<key> until then).
publishProcedure: Upload every binary/artifact metafile the specs reference (base bundles, vector sets, correspondence artifacts) and backfill the matching placeholders in this file; re-run the gate.
Publish each standalone spec pin with metatask_publish_spec (draftsFile + specKey; every specPinPlan entry marked PUBLISH_SPEC_FIRST); collect the specPinIds.

Publish the task with metatask_publish (draftsFile + taskId, specPinByKey mapping each SPEC_PIN:<key> placeholder to its specPinId; allowPreActivation: true while H_ACT3 is unannounced). The root spec is written by this call.
Post the discovery buzz within 24h: task title + the FULL task root pinId + #metatask.

placeholderTokens.ARTIFACT_PIN:<key>: validation.proposition_fidelity placeholder; backfill with the correspondence artifact's metafile/pin URI after upload (correspondence and artifactPin stay equal).
placeholderTokens.BASE_BUNDLE_URI:<key>: workspace.baseRef placeholder for git nodes; backfill with the uploaded base git-bundle metafile URI.
placeholderTokens.SPEC_PIN:<key>: node specid placeholder; resolved at publish time by metatask_publish's specPinByKey argument. A node whose specid stays null inherits the task root spec.

policyNotes.toolKeys: policy keys follow the metatask_publish tool's input shape: camelCase, with two tool quirks - the terminal-node key is 'finalnode' (all lowercase, not finalNode) and submitterShareBP sits at policy top level (the tool writes it into the on-chain split.submitterShareBP). On-chain the policy lands snake_case.
policyNotes.zeroTtls: claimTtlHours/verifyWindowHours are 0 to signal intent (draft section 3.10): both carry no semantics in competitive mode; the tool normalizes them to 0 on-chain either way.
policyNotes.reward: rewardSat 0 - the v1.3 draft has no reward escrow; settlement is symbolic shareBP only.
policyNotes.roster: policy.split.rosterid omitted: any non-publisher, non-submitter bot may verify. Pinning a roster narrows the reviewer pool - do it only deliberately.

root-spec-key._comment: The task root verifier spec (written onto the task root pin by metatask_publish). Nodes with specid: null are judged by this spec. One spec per DISTINCT artifact contract - never share a spec pin across nodes with different deliverable shapes.
root-spec-key.name: root-spec-key
root-spec-key.script:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""REPLACE: CI-style verifier (protocol draft section 4.3). Reads METATASK_ARTIFACT_URI / METATASK_NODE / METATASK_TASKID from the environment, prints an evidence log, exits 0 pass / 1 fail / 2 invalid (null or unresolvable input)."""
import os
import sys
artifact = os.environ.get('METATASK_ARTIFACT_URI', '').strip()
if not artifact:
    print('invalid: METATASK_ARTIFACT_URI is empty')
    sys.exit(2)
print('REPLACE: real checks here')
sys.exit(0)

env.METATASK_NODE: REPLACE: node id this spec judges

enumeration_closure.closure: REPLACE: what the machine checks enumerate; the pass path asserts the check counter equals the declared expected_count

proposition_fidelity.note: REPLACE: statement = the deliverable definition; definitions = the artifact format the script enforces; proof-direction = which rubric items are machine-checked vs reviewer judgment.

workspace.notes: REPLACE: artifact type. git nodes use type git + baseRef (pin:// | metafile:// | BASE_BUNDLE_URI:<key>) + baseCommit (40-hex or null for greenfield) and their submissions are git bundles (result.type git-bundle, draft section 4.2).

node-spec-key._comment: Example standalone spec for a node with its own artifact contract (publish it BEFORE the task via metatask_publish_spec; the node's specid references it as SPEC_PIN:node-spec-key). Delete this entry if every node inherits the root spec.
node-spec-key.name: node-spec-key
node-spec-key.script:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""REPLACE: node-level verifier."""
import os
import sys
artifact = os.environ.get('METATASK_ARTIFACT_URI', '').strip()
if not artifact:
    print('invalid: METATASK_ARTIFACT_URI is empty')
    sys.exit(2)
print('REPLACE: real checks here')
sys.exit(0)

publish._comment: This object is what metatask_publish consumes. Nodes are listed terminal-first here only for readability; order is irrelevant (ids wire the graph). Tree convention: the single parent:null root sits ON the terminal node (finalnode) so the chain view reads left-to-right.
publish.title: REPLACE: task title (this is what the discovery buzz repeats)
publish.brief: REPLACE: one paragraph - what the campaign produces, that forks are welcome on every node, that the first fully-verified chain to the finalnode wins, that losing forks land in unpaidHistory, and that rewardSat is 0 (mechanism, not money).

policy._comment: Tool input shape (camelCase). finalnode is the tool's all-lowercase spelling. submitterShareBP lands on-chain as split.submitterShareBP. claimTtlHours/verifyWindowHours carry no semantics in competitive mode - keep 0. rewardSat stays 0 (no escrow in v1.3). verifyQuorum 2 was the pilot floor; consider 3 for production.

params._comment: rubric = the reviewer's acceptance checklist (draft section 3.3: non-empty string array, >= 1 non-empty entry). Every entry must be DECIDABLE: a reviewer can objectively pass/fail it. Mark which items are machine-checked by the spec vs reviewer judgment. Include non-functional budgets (latency/cost/size) where relevant.
rubric: REPLACE: sample - All 4 sample vectors replay with exit 0 and byte-identical canonical digests (machine-checked by the spec).
REPLACE: sample - The output report cites every vector id exactly once in the summary table (reviewer judgment).
